import type { Readable } from 'node:stream';

export type Dir = 'N' | 'E' | 'S' | 'W';
export interface Pos { readonly x: number; y?: number }
type Mapped<T> = { [K in keyof T as `get${Capitalize<string & K>}`]-?: () => T[K] };
type Cond<T> = T extends string ? 'str' : T extends number ? 'num' : never;

export enum Color { Red = 'RED', Green = 'GREEN' }

export abstract class Base<T extends object = {}> implements Iterable<T> {
  protected constructor(private readonly items: T[] = []) {}
  abstract name(): string;
  *[Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<T> { yield* this.items; }
  static create<U extends object>(this: new (items: U[]) => Base<U>, ...items: U[]): Base<U> { return new this(items); }
}

export function assertIs<T>(v: unknown, guard: (x: unknown) => x is T): asserts v is T {
  if (!guard(v)) throw new Error('nope');
}

export const f = async <T,>(x: T | null): Promise<NonNullable<T>> => x!;
declare module 'foo' { export const bar: number; }
namespace NS { export const x = 1 satisfies number; }
const tuple = [1, 'a'] as const;
let r: Readable | undefined;
export { NS, tuple, r };
function overload(x: string): string;
function overload(x: number): number;
function overload(x: any) { return x; }
export default overload;
